entities.summary: Cameron "Cammy" Smith is a retired Scottish curler from Perthshire. He was the longtime lead for his brother Kyle. During his career, he competed for Great Britain at the 2018 Winter Olympics in PyeongChang, South Korea, placing fifth. He also played for Scotland at two European Curling Championships, two World Junior Curling Championships and the 2013 Winter Universiade, winning the 2013 World Junior Curling Championships. Cameron Smith was a scientists & inventors from Perth (b. 1993-12-11, Perth). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
